interpretation.supported: The new bidirectional concept is materially different from the old schedule reversal: independently solved left/right feasibility relations can meet on one exact separator assignment and replay cleanly to the root on the frozen structured corpus.
interpretation.rejected: Exhaustively searching every bounded separator and component bipartition is an economical way to find the meeting point in R0.
interpretation.dominant_blocker: separator discovery overhead, not the exact meet itself

successor.design: Advisory structural sensor proposes only a tiny candidate separator set; every proposal is exact-verified; high-regret/no-confidence cases skip meet and fall back without exhaustive discovery.
successor.relation_to_R6: This directly matches current TRUMP R6 separation of advisory cost routing from exact proof authority.
